solutions.semantics: Destination owns requests. Source owns the handoff record and retry identity. No distributed transaction.

choices.label: Service Desk in this application
prerequisites: Uses the reviewed local-developer service identity; no production grants are changed.

choices.label: A separately running Service Desk
prerequisites: Requires an explicitly configured destination, tenant mapping and authorized service identity. The Studio does not provision another product automatically.

solutions.semantics: Product-owned recorded analysis calls authorized source metadata and a verified local RF-DETR companion through fixed public ports. No shared domain database.

choices.label: Verified local RF-DETR CPU companion
prerequisites: Requires the separately installed, digest-verified local recording/model profile. Product selection does not install assets or grant permissions.
